She is on low-dose lisinopril and occasional acetaminophen, but hypertension remains uncontrolled. Social barriers including lack of reliable transportation, limited education, and involvement in risk activities have limited her ability to attend appointments and adhere to therapy. No recent labs or follow‑up visits have been documented since 2018.
